text: Long catch-up with Ximena. Her mum had the hip replacement on Tuesday and is home already, walking with a frame. Ximena's taking most of next week off to look after her. Remind me to drop round some soup sometime next week. Ximena also mentioned she's applied for the practice manager job at the surgery, interview probably early next month. Her brother is no help at all, lives in Madrid and just phones.

Hassan finally heard back from the logistics firm, second interview is June 3rd. He's quietly confident but his wife Mariam is more nervous than he is. Text him good luck the night before. Their eldest, Hamza, is doing his GCSEs over the summer as well so the house is chaos. Mariam's started baking to cope, apparently.
Coffee with Caroline. Her son Callum got into the apprenticeship scheme he applied for in the spring, starts end of the month. She's thrilled. He's mad about engines, always has been.
Kalani's surgery got cancelled again, third time now. She's fed up. Hospital say maybe early March. Her partner Jonah is doing all the school runs meanwhile.
Imani rang. Her brother Jamal has been in hospital since the weekend with pneumonia, they think he'll be out sometime next week. She sounded exhausted. Must call her Friday to see how he's doing.

Bethany has a panel interview for the head of year job on 5/14. She's terrified of panels. Her husband's away that week so she's also juggling the kids on her own. Send her something encouraging the morning of.
Astrid's dog Pepper had a lump removed, all benign thankfully. Astrid said she barely slept the night before. Pepper is wearing the cone of shame and hates it.
Ran into Matilda and her dad at the pharmacy. He's recovering from a knee op, getting about with crutches. Matilda's been driving him to physio twice a week.

Olga applied for three jobs this month, heard nothing back from any. She's starting to doubt herself. Her sister Neha thinks she should go back to agency work. I should forward her that vacancy from Rossi & Co.

Neha and her husband Rahul are off to Lisbon over the summer for their tenth anniversary. Rahul's planning it as a surprise, she knows nothing. Don't mention it to her! He's asked me to help pick a restaurant for the night of June 3rd, she loves seafood but can't stand anything spicy. Also need to find out if their cat Miso can come to ours while they're away.
Yetunde got the job!! Starts at the council on September 8th. Her mum cried on the phone apparently. Need to get her a card and something nice for her new desk.
Anjali's appointment with the cardiologist is May 22nd. She's playing it down but her daughter Divya says the palpitations are getting worse. Ring Anjali the day after to see what they said.
Jonah's interview at the hospital trust went well, he thinks. They said they'd let him know end of the week. He'd been prepping for ages.
Hamza tore his ACL playing five-a-side. Op scheduled for early March, then months of rehab. He's gutted about missing the season. His girlfriend Sara is moving in partly to help out.
Rahul's dad passed away on Saturday. Funeral is sometime next week, date tbc. Rahul's flying back to Mumbai Thursday. Message him tonight, and ask Neha if there's anything we can do.
Lwazi mentioned he's been applying for remote roles, mostly UX. Wants out of agency life. His partner Ann is on maternity leave, baby due June 10th.
Errands: prescription pickup, return the parcel, book my own dentist check-up for sometime late November.
Sara's stepmum is having a hysterectomy on July 2nd. Sara is going up for a week after to help. She's quite anxious about the whole thing.

Lunch with Liam and Björn. Björn has his citizenship interview 6/18, Liam's been quizzing him every night. Liam's own job hunt is stalled. They're getting a cat in the autumn, already arguing about names. Remind me to ask Björn how the interview went.
Mehmet's mum's cataract op went fine yesterday. She's not allowed to bend over for a fortnight, which she's ignoring. He's popping in every evening.

Reggie (Reg) Murphy got made redundant on Friday. Takes it well on the surface but Bridget says he's not sleeping. He's got an interview lined up with a builders' merchant early next month. Check in with him over the weekend.
Bridget's daughter starts nursing school end of August. Bridget is already dreading the empty nest.
Divya had her wisdom teeth out, face like a hamster. Off work until Monday. She loves those salted caramel truffles, wd be a good get-well thing.
Suzanne told me her husband's been offered a job in Leeds, they might move over the summer. She hasn't decided whether to go yet. Her kids don't know.
Callum's grandad is in for a triple bypass on April 9th. Callum's trying to keep it together for his mum. He's got his own uni interviews the same month. Remember to text Callum on the 9th.

Vanessa got the promotion to senior analyst! Announced today. She's also running the Bristol 10k on October 26th. Congrats card for Vanessa, and maybe sponsor her run. Her mum is coming over from Dublin for the race and staying till the end of the month. Vanessa's also been training with Callum on Sunday mornings, they're both obsessed with their split times.
Blessing's waiting on results from her MRI, should hear sometime next week. She's trying not to think about it. Her sister Ann flew in from Lagos to be with her.

Ann and her husband are hosting a christening for the baby on Sunday 3/29. We're invited. I'm bringing the cake. Ann said the baby's been sleeping through, finally, and her husband goes back to work the week after. Her mum is flying in from Accra on 3/26 and staying for a fortnight. Nothing to do really except remember the cake.

Kalani's son Liam is applying to med school, personal statement due end of October. Kalani's proofreading it every night and losing her mind. He wants to do paediatrics. Her husband thinks he should take a gap year first and they've been bickering about it all week. Meanwhile her own appraisal at work is on 11/4, she's hoping it leads to a pay rise.

Caroline's mother-in-law fell and broke her wrist last week. Caroline's been doing the hospital visits because her husband's working nights. She's shattered. I should take her out for a drink once things calm down.
Hassan's daughter got into the grammar school. He's over the moon. Their dog Biscuit is turning one on May 1st too, they're throwing him a little party, ridiculous.
Interview prep for my own thing on Thursday. Iron the shirt, print portfolio, leave by 8.
Imani is pregnant! Due early March. She's had awful morning sickness. Her husband Jamal is already painting the nursery.
Mariam's been off since her gallbladder surgery, back at work end of the month hopefully. She's vegan so no point sending chocolates, maybe fruit or a plant. Order something for her this week.

Astrid had a phone screen with that Danish design studio Tuesday, next round is a portfolio review on June 12th. She's never presented in English before and is really nervous. Wish her luck on the 11th.

Matilda's partner Hamza is having a scan on his shoulder on 8/4. They think it's a rotator cuff tear. He's a carpenter so if it's bad he can't work for weeks. Matilda's worried about money. She asked whether I knew anyone hiring part time, she'd take anything. Their little boy has an ear op on 8/12 too, so it's a lot in one month. Ask around at work about part-time roles for Matilda.
Olga's nan turned ninety last week, big family lunch, Olga made the cake. Nan wants a tablet so she can video call the grandkids.
Spoke to Neha. Her son failed his driving test, second attempt, retaking it end of November. He's taking it really hard. She asked if I'd give him a couple of practice drives.

Yetunde and her husband Lwazi postponed their trip to Cape Town until early March because his mum is having chemo. Yetunde's been taking her to appointments. Lwazi's mum is a tough one, keeps cracking jokes. Call Yetunde sometime next week, she's carrying a lot.
Anjali's interview for the deputy head role is on 4/30. She's done the prep, just needs to get through the presentation. Her mum is coming down to mind the kids that day.
Jonah got the hospital job. Starts on July 1st. Need to send congrats.
Hamza's brother Mehmet just got engaged to his girlfriend, wedding probably summer next year. Hamza's best man, already panicking about the speech.
Rahul's back at work after his hernia repair but still not lifting anything. He's coeliac, so remember that if we do the team lunch.

Long chat with Lwazi on the phone. His mum's out of hospital after the stroke and staying with them until she's steadier on her feet, probably until the end of the month. Ann's handling most of it with the baby in tow. Lwazi has an interview at the uni on June 5th he nearly pulled out of. He mentioned he still wants to do the Comrades marathon one day. I must drop off a meal for them this weekend.

Sara had her ankle reconstruction yesterday, went smoothly. She'll be in a boot until mid-July. Her flatmate Bethany is doing the shopping. Sara is really into audiobooks at the moment, an Audible voucher wd be perfect.
Liam's girlfriend broke up with him, the wedding's off. He's moving back to his parents' place end of the month. He's not in a good way. Take him for a pint sometime next week.
Björn's dad has his bowel cancer screening follow-up on 9/16. Björn's flying out to Malmö the week before. He's trying to sound casual.
Mehmet applied for the site manager job at Barros Construction, closing date May 14. He asked me to read his cover letter. Do that tonight.
Reggie's wife Bridget had her knee scope done last Friday, she's already back gardening against doctor's orders. Their granddaughter Ximena starts school in September.
Quick one: Divya's mum is in hospital again, the infection came back. Divya said she's fine but she clearly isn't.
Suzanne's interview went badly, she thinks. They asked about the gap on her CV and she froze. She'll hear end of next week either way. Text her Friday to see if she heard anything.
Callum and his girlfriend Vanessa Kim are moving into their first flat on June 21st. Vanessa's parents are helping with the deposit. They need a toaster apparently.
Vanessa's brother is in rehab after his accident. She visits every Sunday. She's been quieter lately, struggling a bit I think.
Blessing's husband had a hernia op today. Went fine, home tomorrow. Her kids are with their grandma for a few days.
Grocery run, pay the gas bill, and book the car in for an MOT sometime before the end of the month.
Ann told me about her new job at the library, started Monday. Loves it. Her old boss was a nightmare so this is a big relief.

Ximena Novak, or Mena as everyone calls her, has her final interview for the nursing post on 7/9. She's anxious about the clinical scenario part. Her partner Kalani has been running mock questions with her. Afterwards they're off to Hawaii to see Kalani's family over the summer. Remember to text Mena good luck the night before, and ask how it went after.
Bethany's grandma has a hearing aid fitting sometime next week. Bethany's taking her. Grandma refuses to admit she can't hear.

Talked to Jamal for ages. His mum had a bad fall in April and has been in and out of hospital ever since, physio three times a week now. His sister Imani does mornings, he does evenings, and their brother Hassan is useless apparently. Jamal also has a phone interview for a remote job on June 3rd at 10am which he's quite nervous about because he hasn't interviewed in eight years. Don't forget to check in with him after.
Olga Petrov's back op is booked for early March. She's terrified of anaesthetic. Her daughter Matilda is coming home from uni for it. Visit Olga the week after.
